title: Metal found near the Serpent Mound, area of activity
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of Metal found near the Serpent Mound, area of activity, about unspecified at Serpent Mound, Ohio, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: because where this metal was found was near the Indian serpent mound,

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he attracts UFOs, passes on something told to him by a man named Timothy Taylor about a piece of metal. According to Bledsoe, the metal was found near the Serpent Mound, an ancient Native American earthwork in Ohio shaped like a snake, an area he links with strange activity. The point is that the find and the place may be connected.
